descriptions.1: Cluster 1: Mature Conventional Gas — declining vertical wells, deep formations, East/South Texas
descriptions.2: Cluster 2: Mature Conventional Oil/Mixed — Gulf Coast formations, further declined, more P&A
descriptions.3: Cluster 3: Legacy End-of-Life — 40-year-old nearly depleted conventional wells
descriptions.4: Cluster 4: Modern Shale/Tight — young wells at or near peak, Barnett/Haynesville/Eagle Ford
descriptions.5: Cluster 5: Active Horizontal — 100% currently producing, high-productivity horizontal wells
